title: Can Make Palindrome from Substring
summary: Given a string s and an array of queries where each query is represented as [lefti, righti, ki], you are to determine if the substring s[lefti...righti] can be rearranged and up to ki characters within this range can be replaced with any lowercase English letter to form a palindrome.
statement: Given a string s and an array of queries where each query is represented as [lefti, righti, ki], you are to determine if the substring s[lefti...righti] can be rearranged and up to ki characters within this range can be replaced with any lowercase English letter to form a palindrome. For each query, return a boolean value indicating whether it is possible to form a palindrome under these conditions. Note that each letter can only be replaced once per query, and no query alters the original string s .
constraints: One replacement can repair two odd character counts.
hints: A palindrome can contain at most one odd-frequency character.
Store a prefix XOR mask toggling the bit for each character.
The substring mask is prefix[right+1] XOR prefix[left]; half its odd-bit count is the required replacements.
Each replacement pairs two odd counts, so odd_count//2<=k is necessary and sufficient.

tests.explanation: abcda has two odd pairs repairable once; bc cannot be a palindrome without replacement.
A one-character substring is already a palindrome.
